text:
maria: heads up — we need final signoff on the Dedicated Capacity ramp playbook. GPU shipment ETAs updated, need owners for rack config + perf tests. cc @dan @lee

dan: got shipment ETA from vendor: H100 batch arriving 2026-04-07 (tracking 3 of 12). need hostnames for racks.

lee: I'm owner for rack + networking. scheduled power tests Wed. can take perf test ownership too but need test harness ready.

anu: test harness (bench-v2) in repo, PR #482 needs review. quick note: change to batch_size default breaks some runs.

maria: @anu can you link PR?

anu: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482

dan: for capacity reservations — sales wanted 800 TFLOPS reserved by May 1. ops note: we can commit 3 racks now (24 GPUs each) and ramp more after validation.

lee: power: pods for rack-7 reported breaker trips in simulation, will swap PDUs Monday.

maria: Who's doing canary traffic routing/rollout config? we need automatic fallback to hosted models during failover.

dan: I'll draft routing policy. plan: 5% traffic to dedicated for canary, 30% staging, fallback ttl 30s.

lee: need to set KV cache warmup before canary — otherwise cold-start spikes. add prewarm job:
```
kubectl run prewarm --image=bench:v2 --restart=OnFailure --env BATCH=32
```

ops-bot: Deploy ticket created: DED-CAP-1246. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DED-CAP-1246

maria: timeline recap: vendor ETA 2026-04-07, power tests Wed, PDUs Monday, PR review by @anu by EOD Tue, routing draft by @dan by Thu. owners: rack/net=lee, routing=dan, tests=anu. any blockers?

anu: blocking: perf-config change in PR needs consensus. I'll post diff summary shortly.

lee: no blockers from my side. will post power test logs in this thread.

dan: adding note: customer reservations need signed MSA before May 5. Sales pinged.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the playbook and ping infra-oncall for Wed window.

lee: ack

anu: ack

dan: ack
